description: Make a headless multi-agent chat Conan's primary surface, replacing the terminal. A project-grouped thread sidebar drives headless claude (claude -p stream-json) sessions; a token-streaming transcript renders reasoning, collapsible tool cards, inline diffs and plan cards; interactive tool-approval keeps it safe with no terminal fallback; a fused prompt/skill/tool activity spine gives navigation + observability t3-code lacks; and a sigil composer (@ files/folders, $ skills, / commands) plus model/permission chips drive it. T2-lite persistence (thread table + reconstruct-from-JSONL + claude --resume). Claude-only behind the existing AgentDriver seam. Built on the Level-2 spike already merged (src/agent/, ChatPane.tsx, useAgentChat.ts, /ws/agent). Ordered so a usable V1-CORE checkpoint (through US-012) lands for dogfooding before the richness layer.

userStories.title: Per-session working directory + robust headless spawn in the driver
userStories.description: As a chat user, I want each session to run in a working directory I choose, so the agent operates on the right project (no pty supplies cwd anymore).
acceptanceCriteria: The /ws/agent client prompt frame accepts an optional `cwd` string; the first prompt of a session fixes the launch cwd (extend AgentLaunchOpts in src/agent/driver.ts + attachAgent in src/agent/index.ts)
ClaudeDriver spawns claude in that cwd instead of the boot-time getActiveCwd(); no cwd supplied falls back to getActiveCwd()

Spawn resolves the binary + PATH via a login shell so a Finder-launched bundle finds claude/node/git — mirror detectClaude() (src/doctor/claude.ts) and terminal resolveCommand()'s -i -l pattern; prefer CONAN_CLAUDE_BIN then the resolved path
Existing single-turn flow still drives a prompt to a `result` event with no regression
Build the gateway with `npm start` (NOT `npm run dev` tsx-watch, which kills ptys) when editing from an in-dock session; note in commit
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend. Extends the spike's AgentDriver/ClaudeDriver/attachAgent. Suggested skills: none.

userStories.title: Token-level streaming + reasoning events in the driver
userStories.description: As a user, I want the transcript to stream token-by-token and show the agent's reasoning, so it feels alive instead of batch.
acceptanceCriteria: ClaudeDriver launches with `--include-partial-messages`; the NDJSON partial/stream events are parsed into incremental `assistant-text` deltas emitted as they arrive
Thinking/reasoning content is emitted as a distinct `reasoning` AgentEvent kind (separate from assistant-text) so the UI can render it collapsed
Whole-message fallback still works if partial events are absent (no double-render: the final assistant message must not duplicate already-streamed text)
AgentEvent union in src/agent/driver.ts gains the `reasoning` kind; ui/src/hooks/useAgentChat.ts mirrors it
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend + shared type. The de-dup between streamed deltas and the final message block is the tricky part. Suggested skills: none.

userStories.title: Graceful interrupt (cancel turn, keep session)
userStories.description: As a user, I want Stop to cancel the current turn without killing my conversation, so I don't lose context.
acceptanceCriteria: The {type:'interrupt'} frame cancels the in-flight turn via the stream-json control channel (control_request) rather than killing the process; the session/process survives and accepts the next prompt

If the control-channel interrupt is not supported by the installed claude, fall back to the current kill behavior BUT surface it honestly (an `exit`/notice) — do not silently pretend the session survived
After a graceful interrupt, a follow-up prompt in the same session continues the conversation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend. Verify what the installed claude's stream-json control protocol supports; document the finding in the commit. Suggested skills: none.

userStories.title: Interactive tool-approval round-trip in the driver + WS (Supervised mode)
userStories.description: As a user with no terminal fallback, I want to approve/deny each tool call in Supervised mode, so the agent can't run destructive tools unattended.
acceptanceCriteria: EARLY SPIKE: determine the CLI subscription-path mechanism for interactive permission — a stdin permission control request vs a `--permission-prompt-tool` MCP shim — and document the choice in the commit. MUST keep subscription auth (claude -p), never ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (sk-ant-oat* is blocked, CLAUDE.md gotcha)
In Supervised (`--permission-mode default` or the chosen equivalent), a tool needing approval emits a `permission-request` AgentEvent {id, kind (command|file-read|file-change), summary, detail}

The driver accepts a {type:'permission-response', id, decision} frame with decision in accept | acceptForSession | decline | cancel; acceptForSession auto-approves that tool kind for the rest of the session
The turn blocks on the pending request and resumes on the response; decline continues the turn without the tool; cancel ends the turn (session survives)
acceptEdits / bypassPermissions modes never emit permission-requests (auto-approved as today)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend — the riskiest story; sequenced early on purpose (foundational for Supervised default). Suggested skills: none.

Streamed deltas append to the current assistant item in place (no flof duplicate bubbles); reasoning items render as their own collapsible entries
sessionId survives across turns; pendingApproval clears when responded to or the turn ends
